title.zh: 将达义市陆运署延伸办公室改设为正式区办公室并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Extension Office of the Land Transportation Office in Taguig City Into A Regular District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Extension Office of the Land Transportation Office in Taguig City Into A Regular District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Văn phòng mở rộng Land Transportation Office tại Thành phố Taguig thành Văn phòng Khu vực Chính quy, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะสำนักงานขยาย Land Transportation Office ในเมือง Taguig เป็น สำนักงานเขตปกติ และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Kantor Perluasan Land Transportation Office di Kota Taguig menjadi Kantor Distrik Reguler, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Pejabat Lanjutan Land Transportation Office di Bandar Taguig kepada Pejabat Daerah Biasa, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2025/ra_12184_2025.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office in Taguig City is hereby converted into a regular district office.

The Secretary of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the LTO District Office in Taguig City, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
